svg.aria-label: The full mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Phase 0 Intake: configuration record, citation verification: mark only or strict (stop); you skip Phase 1, giving your own sources? (question); Phase 1 Literature strategist: screens your sources, searches for what they miss, unless you say your sources only (agent); You review the sources: add or remove, optional (stop); Phase 2 Structure architect: outline and evidence map (agent); Outline approval (stop); Phase 3 Argument builder (agent); Phase 4 Draft writer: 4a pre-commitment, 4b draft and self-scores (agent); Visualization, when there are quantitative results: figure code and LaTeX inclusion code (agent); Phase aborted: you decide (stop); Phase 5a Citation compliance: corrects format and DOIs, flags a wrong source, stops on a claim not in its source (agent); Phase 5b Abstract agent, in parallel (agent); Phase 6 Peer reviewer, round 1: 6a scoring plan, 6b scores and verdict (agent); You decide (stop); Draft writer: revises, a full draft again (agent); Peer reviewer, round 2: the revised sections (agent); RAISE compliance check, warnings only (agent); Phase 7 Formatter: adds the AI disclosure and limitations if missing, places the figures, converts, compiles with tectonic or xelatex (agent); Final checklist: content, format, required elements, DOIs; compile errors fixed, warnings accepted (agent); Hard gate: a citation unverified, fabricated or unsupported, or blocked under strict? (question); Output refused: you fix it (stop); Output package (agent) | paper, as built: Phase 0 Intake agent: config.md; citation verification, the number of sources [5.Q item 6], the closing review, the claim check, the incremental checks [5.Q (i)] (stop); you skip Phase 1, giving your own sources? (question); Session: one literature strategist, or several with a merge, each start's brief written by the session, the choice in config.md Decisions [Paper's lit-review as academic-paper's] (question); Literature strategists, the starts the session briefs, at once [Paper's lit-review as academic-paper's] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, the merge the session briefs: review.md and refs.bib [Paper's lit-review as academic-paper's] (ruled, only when needed); Phase 1 Literature strategist: screens your sources, searches for what they miss, unless you say your sources only (agent); You review the sources: add or remove, optional (stop); Phase 2 Structure architect: outline and evidence map (agent); Outline approval (stop); Phase 3 Argument builder (agent); Phase 4 Draft writer: 4a pre-commitment, 4b main.tex whole and self-scores [5.Q (i)] (ruled); Visualization, when there are quantitative results: the figures, placed by patch [5.Q (i)] (ruled, only when needed); A generator phase aborted (stop); Phase 5a Citation compliance: format, DOI, retractions, and each claim against the passage read in its source's full text, unless you said no at intake [5.Q (i)] (ruled); The citation style to confirm, when more than half the cited entries follow another style than the Citation Format row (stop); A claim the run cannot support: the check stops at the first claim not held, and the stop is raised once the agent has ended [5.Q (i)] (stop); A reference that cannot be confirmed, only under strict [5.Q (i)] (stop); Phase 5b Abstract agent, in parallel: one patch [5.Q (i)] (ruled); Phase 6 Peer reviewer, round 1: 6a scoring plan, 6b scores and verdict (agent); The draft review does not pass (stop); Draft writer, resumed: revises, the whole draft as one patch over every block [5.Q (i)] (ruled); Draft writer, resumed: the statements the result files do not bear out, as a patch [5.Q (i)] (ruled, only when needed); Citation compliance, resumed: the cited sentences of the patch, unless you said no at intake [5.Q (i)] (ruled, only when needed); Peer reviewer, resumed, round 2: the revised sections (agent); Script, run by the session: lookup.py cite-keys and check-urls; latexmk compile with the engine of the class [5.Q (i)] (script); Draft writer, resumed: the reference fix for a missing entry, the compile fix for a failed compile or a box over 10pt [5.Q (i)] (ruled, only when needed); Phase 7 Formatter: targets, journal formatting, cover letter, AI disclosure, as patches [5.Q (i)] (ruled); Final checklist: content, format, required elements, DOIs; compile errors fixed, warnings accepted (agent); /writing review, unless you said no at intake [5.Q (i)] (ruled, only when needed); Draft writer: the findings you pick, or the autonomous pass, as a patch [5.Q (i)] (ruled, only when needed); Output package (agent); At every patch: a structural patch, a patch that does not apply, a script failed [5.Q (i)] (stop); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
